exposure: Baskent Sickle Cell Medical Care Development Program (BASCARE)
Low citrate infusion in routine prophylactic automatic erythrocyte exchange (ARCE)
Leukocyte-filtered and irradiated blood for transfusion
Magnetic resonance imaging methods (T2*) for hemosiderosis management
Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation protocol for adult patients
outcome: Better analysis and interpretation of complication and mortality data
Improved vaccination rates against influenza and pneumococcal disease
Prevention of maternal and fetal mortality
Successful outcomes in allogeneic peripheral stem cell transplantation
Prolonged life span of SCD patients
cohort: The study included 376 sickle cell disease patients receiving the BASCARE program and 249 control subjects, located in the Eastern Mediterranean region.
finding: The BASCARE program significantly improved patient care for individuals with sickle cell disease, leading to better management of complications, increased vaccination rates, and a prolonged life span.
